name: meridian-real-estate
description: Meridian — premium real estate platform (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n server,client -c teal,gold "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server --omit=dev
